title: brio course content
description: Versioned, structured JSON for a chapter of teacher-authored course content. See docs/schema/DESIGN.md for the design rationale and docs/adr/0004 for the decision.

schemaVersion.description: Integer schema version. Bumped only on breaking structural changes; additive changes (new block/exercise types) do not bump it.

id.description: Author-assigned, human-readable, stable chapter id. Used as the RAG citation anchor.

subject.description: Free-text discipline label, e.g. 'mathematiques'. Not a controlled taxonomy yet.

level.description: Free-text school level, e.g. '3e', 'seconde'. Not a controlled taxonomy yet.

status.description: Editorial publication status. Absent means 'published'. Ingestion always applies the file value (ADR 0010).

nodeId.description: Readable slug id, unique within the whole chapter document. Stable across edits so RAG citations and cross-references keep resolving.

plainText.description: A short, single-language (French) plain-text string. No markup.

richText.description: Inline text that may contain minimal, whitelisted inline markup as a string (e.g. **bold**, *italic*). Kept as a string so it renders identically on web and mobile via one shared inline parser.

difficulty.description: Coarse difficulty band. An open enum: renderers must tolerate unknown values.

competencies.description: References into the controlled competency referential (content/referentiel/, ADR 0009). Code grammar is enforced here; existence in the referential is checked by scripts/check-competencies.mjs and at ingestion. An empty array is allowed.

kind.description: Editorial role of the section. 'lesson' sections carry teaching content (and may embed inline exercises); 'exercises' sections are dedicated practice/assessment sets. Open enum: renderers must tolerate unknown kinds.

blocks.description: Ordered content stream. Exercise nodes may appear inline anywhere in this stream (typically in 'lesson' sections) or as the whole stream (in 'exercises' sections).

block.description: A content block. Discriminated by 'type'. The union is OPEN: unknown types validate against the fallback so adding a new block type needs no migration of existing content.

level.description: Heading depth within a section. Sections and chapters own their own titles; this is for sub-headings.

latex.description: LaTeX source, rendered by KaTeX/MathJax on web and an equivalent renderer on mobile so the same source displays identically.

asset.description: Opaque asset reference (asset id or path). Asset storage/serving is out of scope for the schema.

alt.description: Accessibility text. Required so content stays accessible on every client.

variant.description: Semantic emphasis. Open enum: renderers must tolerate unknown variants and fall back to a neutral style.

language.description: Highlighting hint, e.g. 'python'. Optional and free-text.

exerciseBlock.description: An exercise embedded in the content stream. The same shape is used inline in a lesson and inside a dedicated 'exercises' section. 'additionalProperties' is intentionally NOT closed here: type-specific fields are contributed by the allOf branches below, and unknown exercise types may carry their own fields (open union).

exerciseType.description: Discriminates the exercise family. Open enum: an unknown exerciseType still validates the shared fields, so new exercise types need no migration.

prompt.description: The question statement shown to the student.

explanation.description: Optional worked correction shown after answering. Grounds AI correction feedback.

multiple.description: true if several choices may be correct.

acceptedAnswers.description: Answers counted correct (exact match after normalisation).

caseSensitive.description: Controls case-folding only. NFD normalisation and accent removal always apply regardless of this flag — a student typing on a phone keyboard should not be penalised for missing accents. Use true for answers where letter case is semantically meaningful: variable names (x ≠ X), point labels (M ≠ m). Default false for natural-language answers.

numericFields.description: Extra fields required when exerciseType = 'numeric'. Tolerance lets machine correction accept near-answers.

tolerance.description: Absolute tolerance: an answer is correct if |given - answer| <= tolerance.

freeTextFields.description: Extra fields required when exerciseType = 'free-text'. Corrected by the AI against a reference; not auto-gradable by exact match.

referenceAnswer.description: Model answer the AI correction is grounded in.

rubric.description: Optional grading criteria to ground AI feedback.

orderingFields.description: Extra fields required when exerciseType = 'ordering'. 'items' are given in the CORRECT order; clients shuffle for display.

figureBlock.description: A declarative mathematical figure rendered as SVG. Coordinates are logical math units; the renderer handles scaling, aspect-ratio preservation, and Y-axis inversion. See ADR 0013.

alt.description: Accessibility text. Required — a figure without a textual equivalent is invalid, not merely discouraged.

figureSpec.description: Geometric primitives in logical math coordinates. coordinateSpace is optional: when absent the renderer derives it from the bounding box of all points plus a 15 % margin.

placement.description: Where to place the point label relative to the dot. 'auto' lets the renderer choose. Open enum: renderers must tolerate unknown values.

figureCircle.description: Circle defined by center + one of: a named point it passes through ('through', preferred — matches compass phrasing) or an explicit radius. Exactly one of through/radius is required.

figureAngleMark.description: Marks the angle at 'vertex' formed by the rays toward 'from' and 'to'. right:true renders the classic square marker; omitting it (or false) renders a small arc.

figureLengthMark.description: Tick coding on a segment to indicate equal lengths. 'segment' is the concatenation of the from and to point names (e.g. 'AB' for the segment from A to B). Segments sharing the same tick count are asserted equal by CI.

figureLabel.description: Free text label placed at explicit logical coordinates, not attached to a named point.

figureNumberLine.description: A graduated horizontal axis. Tick positions are derived from from/to/step; labelEvery controls which ticks get a label (defaults to step). marks adds emphasis dots at arbitrary values.

unknownBlock.description: Forward-compatibility fallback. A block whose 'type' is none of the known ones still validates as long as it carries an id and a string type. This is what makes adding a new block/exercise type additive rather than a migration.
